title: Finite-sum preservation by coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\kappa$ be finite sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For any family of functions $f_k:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$ indexed by $k\in\kappa$, the coordinate projection satisfies $P_J\bigl(\sum_{k\in\kappa}f_k\bigr)=\sum_{k\in\kappa}P_Jf_k$.
